# Pixel Studio

> Pixel-art characters described as JSON (shapes on a skeleton, materials, animations) and rendered to sprites at any size. Agents are welcome here.

## Try a look

- [Playground](/studio/play.html): one character, set up entirely by its URL (`?c=goose-root&view=front&anim=waddle&skin=party&res=64#spec=<payload>`).
- [Playground guide](/packages/pixel-studio/docs/playground.md): URL options, how the payload changes a character, examples, and `window.playground` for browser agents.
- [Payload schema](/studio/play.schema.json): JSON Schema of the `#spec=` payload.

## Start

- [Getting started](/packages/pixel-studio/docs/getting-started.md): install, write a character as a variant, validate, preview, bundle, put it on a page.

## Reference

- [Character format](/packages/pixel-studio/docs/SPEC.md): materials, parts, shapes, animations, skins, variants, style.
- [Figures](/packages/pixel-studio/docs/figures.md): the skeletons characters are built on, and front/back views.
- [Example characters](/packages/pixel-studio/examples/goose-root.json): goose-base, goose-root, goose-sudo, goose-phreak, goose-kiddie, goose-greylag, moss, fox, pip, robot, slime (`/packages/pixel-studio/examples/<name>.json`).
- [Runtime](/packages/pixel-studio/docs/runtime.md): `<pixel-sprite>` for putting a character on a web page.
- [Stage](/packages/pixel-studio/docs/stage.md): `<pixel-stage>`, characters that walk, climb and hide on a page's own elements.
- [CLI](/packages/pixel-studio/docs/cli.md): `pixel validate | preview | ascii | bundle | export | where | resolve | figures | brief`.
- [JavaScript API](/packages/pixel-studio/docs/api.md): every export of the engine.
